title: Brian Schottenheimer on George Pickens: It's going to play out the way it plays out

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brian Schottenheimer on George Pickens: It's going to play out the way it plays out
sources.description: The Cowboys used the franchise tag on wide receiver George Pickens, which will pay him $27.298 million on a one-year deal in the absence of a long-term deal.
